abstract: The incidental diagnosis in adult age is very unusual and the presence of clinical symptoms is related to its location, which is most commonly intrapericardial. The presence of intramyocardial teratoma lesions is even rarer and has been reported in few publications. The recommendations for the diagnosis and management of a cardiac teratoma depends upon the imaging studies and the pathological report after surgical excision. The prognosis of surgically treated patient is very good and a complete surgical excision is preferred in order to avoid complications.
abstract_ja: 成人における偶発的な診断は非常に稀であり、臨床症状は腫瘍の部位によって決まるが、多くは心膜内に生じる。心筋内の奇形腫病変はさらに稀で、報告例はわずかである。心臓奇形腫の診断と治療の方針は、画像検査と外科的切除後の病理所見に基づく。外科的切除後の患者の予後は非常に良好であり、合併症を避けるため完全な外科的切除が望ましい。
